output_list.criticism: The div10 function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, but the function only divides by 10, which can lead to overflow and be exploited.
The lockBalances function allows the owner to lock the balances of arbitrary users, which is a vulnerability.
The precalculate function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, but the function only initializes values, which cannot lead to overflow.
The setExportFee function allows the owner to set the export fee to an arbitrary value, which is a vulnerability.
The setHoldingPeriod function allows the owner to set the holding period to an arbitrary value, which is a vulnerability.
The feeFor function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, but the function only calculates fees, which cannot lead to overflow.
